snippet.title: Demonschool DLC and Switch 2 Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Demonschool, our odd RPG with tactical battles, is getting DLC! We're adding even more to the game RPGFan called the best strategy of 2025, and RPGamer called the "most overlooked."

After our recent giant free patch which added New Game Plus, mouse support and a lot of light story elements, we are finally revealing paid DLC.

The focus is on puzzle battles. These are battles in which the player must "solve" a board by clearing it of enemies using the characters given, within one turn. Each puzzle is carefully set up to have one solution. For those who wanted a more puzzling experience out of our battles, this DLC is for you!

In this DLC players will get access to new items which can charge their special attacks, as well as three new unlockable abilities to study, which are usable in the main game. It's deceptively difficult, but makes you feel smart when you get it!

The battles are accompanied by a short side-story with new music, which culminates in a new boss. The DLC should take 3-5 hours to complete without a guide, though it took our creative director around 6. Maybe you're smarter than him! 

We're also bringing the game to Switch 2 with mouse support, improved framerate, and more graphical elements vs the original Switch version. All of this in 2026!

All of this will happen in 2026! Please anticipate!

Buy Demonschool now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1900250/Demonschool/
